trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Verified the service recovered — health checks now passing with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, with a summary describing the failure and the rollback action taken.

The service is now healthy in all regions. A follow-up root-cause investigation of the v2.3.1 release is still needed before it's redeployed.
